name: Summon Lesser Agathion
body:
School conjuration (summoning) [good]; Level arcanist/sorcerer/wizard 5, cleric/oracle/warpriest 5, summoner 4, summoner (unchained) 4, witch 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S, F/DF (a fresh flower and raw meat)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect one summoned creature
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions like summon monster, except it allows you to summon a single cervapral, one vulpinal, 1d3 bishops, 1d3 reptials, or 1d4+1 muldnals.
